rules.rationale: Fungible currency theft needs an attributable quantity and value claim, not per-coin identity.
Ordinary interchangeable inputs use value restitution unless a later policy promotes them to a justified lot.
Perishable food carries shared production and storage history at batch granularity.
Cooked food keeps batch origin without creating one identity per interchangeable item.
A durable lifecycle instance keeps explicit title, custody and theft history.
